a
R(s)=⟨2scos⁡2s,3,−2ssin⁡2s⟩
b
R(s)=⟨2ssin⁡2s+cos⁡2s,3,2scos⁡2s−sin⁡2s⟩
c
R(s)=⟨s2sin⁡(s2)+cos⁡(s2),3,s2cos⁡(s2)−sin⁡(s2)⟩
d
R(s)=⟨2ssin⁡2s+cos⁡2s,3,2scos⁡2s−sin⁡2s⟩
e
R(s)=⟨2scos⁡2s,3,−2ssin⁡2s⟩
